'''Danu 5 (November 28)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|978}} - [[Moiraine]] figures out that the [[Amyrlin]] is quietly gathering a small number of experienced [[Aes Sedai]] to search for the [[Dragon Reborn]]. The five that she is aware of are [[Kerene Nagashi]], [[Aisha Raveneos]], [[Valera Gorovni]], [[Ludice Daneen]] and [[Meilyn Arganya]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Mat]] finds [[Olver]] has followed him into [[Salidar]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Merana]] and another two of the Salidar embassy meet with [[Rand]].
*{{ne|999}} - Construction of the wall around the [[Black Tower]] begins.
